question: Who wrote the book ‘The Ickabog’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**JK Rowling**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ickabog__ is the name of the children’s book released online by J K Rowling.
 
• This book is available free of cost. The chapters are being posted on its website in installments.
 
• This book is suitable for 7-9 years old to read themselves and the theme is related to fairy-tales.
 
• The primary aim behind this book is for children to stay inside in this pandemic and inculcate a reading habit.
 
• Rowling has also announced that she would be donating her author royalties from this book to projects & organisations helping the groups most affected by COVID-19.
 
• JK Rowling is a famous author of Wizarding World Series-Harry Potter.
